thread:
emma: Quick note 10am PT QuantShop POC kickoff on Tue (45m). Sarah asked for a Day-0 playbook + success criteria before the call. Can SE + Security join?

raj_se: I can. Need clarity on prompt types and sample volumes so I can prepare eval harnesses (gen vs rerank vs chat). Also need expected QPS/concurrency for pricing.

sam_prod: I'll draft a one-pager success criteria. Proposed KPIs: gen latency p95 < 300ms, throughput target 60 QPS (burst 120), resume-summary quality >= 85% pass rate, rerank MRR/NDCG targets. Also include rollback triggers.

maria_security: Customer asked about SSO, IP allowlist, and encryption (KMS). If they require VPC peering or on-prem, that will impact timeline. They also want a DPA before uploading samples.

emma: Intake lists three priority flows: 1) resume summarization (generation), 2) internal search reranking (embeddings + reranker), 3) interview assistant (chat). Sarah will upload anonymized samples.

raj_se: Sharing quick prompt/eval snippets to ask them to provide representative data:
- Resume summarization prompt: "Summarize key skills and a 3-line recruiter summary." Eval: check key_skills coverage and summary conciseness.
- Rerank harness: run `python eval_rerank.py --input queries.json --topk 10`. Metrics: MRR, NDCG@10, latency p95.
- Chat smoke: single-turn Q/A set (50 items) with pass/fail tolerance.

raj_se: Also confirm deployment mode: hosted vs Dedicated/Private. Hosted = fastest onboarding, Dedicated/Private = procurement lead time + different pricing.

ops-bot: Calendar: "Redwood 16 QuantShop POC Kickoff" created Tue 10:00am PT (45m). Attendees: emma, raj_se, maria_security, sam_prod, Sarah (QuantShop).

maria_security: Quick pre-kickoff questions for Sarah (please answer before Mon EOD):
- Any regulatory constraints (HIPAA, PCI, special GDPR needs)?
- Will samples be in S3 or on-prem? Contain PHI?
- Required logging/audit retention windows?

emma: Sarah DM: no PHI, standard GDPR. Legal wants a DPA + liability limits before ingest. They prefer hosted to start. Also asked for pricing for a 3-month reserved pool vs PAYG.

sam_prod: I'll prepare two pricing scenarios for kickoff:
- 3-month reserved throughput with a ~20% discount vs PAYG.
- PAYG with usage caps and alerting.
I'll include per-use-case token cost estimates and ops notes for Dedicated if they later request it.

raj_se: Action items (owner / due):
- raj_se: build eval harness + prompt templates; smoke test on 10 samples 1 Mon EOD.
- maria_security: send DPA + encryption/IP allowlist steps; flag private deployment blockers 1 Mon EOD.
- sam_prod: draft success criteria one-pager + pricing scenarios 1 Mon EOD.
- emma: request 1k anonymized resumes + 200 search queries from Sarah; confirm kickoff attendees 1 today.

emma: Tagging for ack. Please react :thumbsup: when you accept your action.

Sarah (QuantShop): Hosted preferred. Will upload anonymized samples to the S3 link once DPA is signed. Thanks for the pricing scenarios.

maria_security: I'll attach the DPA and a short doc on KMS + IP allowlist steps before the call. If they want Dedicated later we'll scope infra and lead times.

sam_prod: Final prep sync Mon 9am PT for owners. I'll attach the one-pager to the kickoff invite.

raj_se: I'll also include a curl example so they can try a smoke prompt against hosted endpoint before the official runs.

emma: Great. We'll capture notes in the kickoff thread and follow up with a short 2-week eval plan (daily runs + mid-review).

(Will post kickoff notes and outcomes in this thread after the meeting.)
